page.layout: One page, title page: centred title lines in roman, italic and capitals, with a list of four books, an imprint line, and a woodcut device in the lower centre. No margin text.
page.notes: Woodcut device below the title: a circular medallion with a seated figure in a landscape, flanked by the letters around the ring (partly legible, the ring reads roughly "...NIA ... EX ... NO..."), within a decorative border. Not transcribed as text. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible and ignored. Dust spots and marks on the page are not printed text. The title lines "digné restituta" and "phicorum" are transcribed as printed; "phicorum" is probably a printer's error for "philosophicorum" but is left as printed. The "ct" in "complectens" and "ctualibus" is a ligature, transcribed as plain letters.
